basic_profile.bio: TrailRunnerGeek is a passionate runner based in Portland, Oregon. He's a software engineer by day and a trail running enthusiast by evening and weekends. With an interest in tech, he loves exploring the latest gadgets and tech trends. When he’s not running or working, he’s likely binging fantasy series on Netflix. He’s married and shares his home with two energetic dogs. He typically browses Reddit during his lunch break and late nights after a run.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: TrailRunnerGeek has a background in computer science, having graduated from Oregon State University. His expertise in software development is complemented by his self-taught knowledge in fitness and nutrition, acquired through years of running and participating in amateur races. He often shares running tips and tech advice on Reddit.
